references.text: Moses gives the same instruction to the tribes of Reuben and Gad that their wives, children, and livestock should remain in the cities while the men go out to war.
Joshua repeats Moses' command that the women, children, and livestock of the eastern tribes should stay in the land that Moses gave them.
The tribes of Reuben and Gad promise to build enclosures for their livestock and cities for their children before they go to war.
Describes the distribution of the land east of the Jordan to the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half-tribe of Manasseh.
Fulfillment of the command: The men of Reuben, Gad, and half-tribe of Manasseh cross the Jordan armed while their families remained behind.
After the conquest, Joshua sends the eastern tribes back to their families and possessions that were waiting for them.
